title: Deceleration reconstruction

baseline.label: Flat ΛCDM reference
baseline.scope: ΛCDM supplies q_fid and the comparison likelihood model, not retained physical dark-energy equations after delta q is added. Standard early-physics continuation and compressed CMB summaries are extra conditional assumptions.
baseline.parameters_reason: No candidate input set is registered. Source illustrative or fitted values are not adopted as prospect parameters.

cosmology.gravity: Unspecified physical dynamics for the reconstruction. GR belongs to the fiducial interpretation; adding delta q does not specify stress-energy or a gravity theory.
cosmology.geometry: Flat homogeneous distance/FLRW kinematic framework, a0=1 and E=H/H0. This is a kinematic family, not a closed physical cosmology.
components: Reference: pressureless matter and Λ in the displayed late-time q_fid; radiation is explicitly omitted there.
Baryon/matter densities and conventional radiation/recombination assumptions enter BAO/CMB-distance calculations, but do not close the reconstructed low-z stress-energy.
No independently defined added dark-energy field, fluid or modified-gravity sector.
modifications: Finite-node cubic/quartic delta q in z, z/(1+z) or log(1+z), with a fixed-zero endpoint and cutoff.
The implied H(z) must be integrated and matched consistently; setting delta q=0 above cutoff only recovers q, not necessarily the same H normalization.
cosmology.background: With E(0)=1, E/E_fid=exp[integral delta q/(1+z) dz]. Exact same-parameter high-z recovery requires the integrated deviation to vanish or an explicit alternative matching prescription.
cosmology.perturbations: Absent: no physical fluid sound speed, stress, field or modified-gravity closure. Planck-derived compressed summaries do not restore full CMB perturbation information.
observables: Minimal test: E(0), cutoff continuity and integrated deviation.
Separately evaluate qdot, jerk j and j+q with joint derivative uncertainty.
Source fits: DESI DR2 BAO, one SN compilation and Planck-derived distance summaries, with optional SH0ES; shared data are not independent evidence.

scope: Audit author q→H matching/early radiation before interpretation or inference.
Lost scope: physical cosmology, perturbations, full CMB likelihood, numerical refit and acceleration-endpoint claims.
A fitted q upturn is not a calibrated finding of decreasing a_ddot, decreasing a_ddot/a or a future end of acceleration.
unknowns: Joint samples, derivative covariance and statistical regularity.
SN/SH0ES common-object/calibration covariance and validity of distance compression.

combination_compatibility.basis: Unchecked beyond the explicitly sourced branch; shared topic membership does not authorize mixing mechanisms.

source_evidence.locator: Sec.II, PDF pp.2-3, Eqs.(1)-(4): explicit flat ΛCDM q reference, radiation omission, finite interpolation and cutoff; original HTML q_fid/cutoff text.
Sec.III.C Eqs.(19)-(22): conditional CMB summaries; Sec.IV Fig.5 and Tables II-IV for conditional fitted feature and comparison evidence.
